panels.description: Ada reaches toward an archive terminal while Leona stops her hand. Keep the upper terminal clear.
The archive displays younger Leona, Adrian and Mera beside three Covenant bands while fractured reservoirs and a locked storehouse appear behind them. Keep the upper archive clear.
Adrian's band remains dark while Mera's band glows in the historical record. Keep the upper display clear.
Leona places her hand on the deciding record in the archive. Keep the upper record clear.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: If I open it, it stays open.
